histogram_bright.adql: SELECT mag_bin, d_bin, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ( SELECT FLOOR(median_mag_g_fov / 0.5) AS mag_bin, FLOOR((median_mag_g_fov - min_mag_g_fov) / mad_mag_g_fov / 0.25) AS d_bin FROM gaiadr3.vari_summary WHERE mad_mag_g_fov > 0 AND num_selected_g_fov >= 10 ) AS h GROUP BY mag_bin, d_bin
